Doc ID: RM-DOC-0116
Title: Canal survey finds further damage; reopening delayed
Outlet: Runewire
Publication Date: 2025-04-20
Source Type: news_report
Event ID: EVT-A
Country: Brenmark
Sector: electronics
Reliability Tier: 2

A survey of the northern channel found further damage to the canal bed. The Serpent Canal Authority said the reopening would be delayed into June.

Forwarders said they now expect canal traffic to stay halted until at least mid-June.
